主要内容: The Genesis G70 luxury sport sedan has been named the Top Aspirational Luxury Car in AutoPacific’s 2019 Ideal Vehicle Awards. AutoPacific’s study evaluates vehicle owners’ preferences, selecting winners based on the lowest desire for change. Over 50,000 owners contributed to the 2019 decision-making process. Erwin Raphael, Chief Operating Officer of Genesis Motor America, stated the award affirms the brand’s approach to meeting owner expectations. The G70 has also won multiple third-party awards, including the 2019 North American Car of the Year and MotorTrend 2019 Car of the Year. It features performance, body strength, refined luxury, and aerodynamic design. Pricing starts at $34,900. Genesis Motor America, based in Fountain Valley, Calif., offers industry-leading warranty and roadside assistance. The brand has received top rankings for quality and owner satisfaction from J.D. Power, AutoPacific, and Strategic Vision. The G70 is part of Genesis’ product lineup, which includes the G90, G80, and G80 Sport models. The award highlights Genesis’ leadership in the luxury automotive space and its ability to meet buyer expectations through holistic design and performance integration.
